source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Electrical - Body and Chassis, p.12-54

procedures.title: Washer pump: remove (Type C depressed park wiper)
steps: Raise the hood.
Disconnect the washer hoses and electrical connections from the pump.
Remove the 3 screws holding pump and cover to the wiper and lift the pump off the gear box.
notes: With the pump off, all working parts are accessible (see figures 84 and 85 in the manual).

procedures.title: Vent grille and windshield wiper cover panel: remove and install
steps: Raise the hood and disconnect the battery ground cable (battery is behind the driver's seat).
Remove the 8 screws in the vent grille.
Move the grille forward and up to lift it off.

With vacuum available, open the cover panel by pulling the wiper cover panel switch down; otherwise remove the plug at the front of the vacuum actuator, insert a screwdriver and push the piston in until the panel rises.
Remove the 4 bolts and bushings holding the panel to the control assembly arms and lift it off.
To install, with the actuator rod EXTENDED, set the panel over the actuator arms and fit the bushings and bolts.
With the actuator closed, line the vent grille up with its brackets, install its screws and reconnect the battery ground cable.

Operate the system and check both panels: set the panel-to-windshield gap with the 2 stop screws D on the rear outboard control links (loosen the lock nuts, turn the screws) to .060 in. at the reveal molding clip at windshield center; the screws bear on plastic pads on the plenum.
Adjust the grille fore and aft in its slotted holes.
Adjust the whole control assembly, grille and panel up or down at the firewall mounting nuts E.

specs.what: wiper cover panel to windshield gap (at center)

notes: The actuator rubber plug is part of the vacuum system; refit/replace it right away.

System: a vacuum actuator on a control assembly swings the panel up and forward, sharing the headlamp cover vacuum source. The console wiper switch energizes a vacuum solenoid behind the tachometer housing, which signals the actuator through a relay. A limit switch, closed only when the panel is fully open, lets the wiper motor run.

procedures.title: Wiper cover panel bumpers: replace
steps: Remove the 8 vent grille screws and lift the grille off, noting where the washer hoses run.
Reach under the cover panel with an offset Phillips screwdriver and replace the soft bumpers if thinner than 3/16 in.
Refit and align the grille, routing the washer hoses correctly.

specs.what: wiper cover panel bumper replacement limit

procedures.title: Wiper cover panel actuator: replace
steps: Disconnect the vacuum hoses from the actuator.
Loosen the lock nut on the turnbuckle rod nut.
Remove the 2 nuts, bolts, washers and bushings holding the actuator to its bracket.
Turn the actuator to work it out of the engine compartment.
Install in reverse order.
notes: View C of figure 86 in the manual.

procedures.title: Wiper cover panel limit switch: replace
steps: Remove the 8 vent grille screws and lift the grille off.
Remove the bolt and bushing from the rod.
Remove the 2 bolts holding the bracket to the plenum panel and take out the assembly.
Remove the bolt holding the switch and take the switch off.
Install in reverse order.
notes: View B of figure 86 in the manual.

procedures.title: Wiper cover panel control assembly: replace
steps: Remove the 8 vent grille screws and lift the grille off.
Remove the screw and bushings fastening the limit switch link to the control assembly (View B).
Remove the cover panel actuator as described above.
Remove the 4 nuts and reinforcements from the outboard studs of the control assembly on the firewall.
Swing the whole control assembly with the cover panel forward and up to remove it for bench work.
Install in reverse order.
Align the grille and panel vertically to the fenders at nuts E; set the .060 in. panel-to-windshield gap at screws D.

specs.what: wiper cover panel to windshield gap

procedures.title: Wiper cover panel vacuum relay: replace
steps: Remove the screws holding the wiper vacuum relay to the inner fender panel.
notes: View A of figure 86 in the manual.
